title.zh: 7-day blockchain outage wipes out a full week of staking rewards after emergency aelf shutdown
title.en: 7-day blockchain outage wipes out a full week of staking rewards after emergency aelf shutdown

current_state.zh: aelf restored public nodes, wallet transfers, trading, and its staking interface after malicious smart-contract activity forced an emergency shutdown that halted block production for roughly a week, erasing a full week of staking rewards while exchange access remains inconsistent across venues.
